method.snapshot: Full unrounded enumerable unit state including HP, coordinates, bossState, statuses and presentationFlags; full events; projectiles, pending summons, elapsed, state and winner, captured at tick 0 and after every production step.
method.numberHandling: Exact IEEE-754 values. No rounding, tolerance, numeric masking or field omission. Tagged NaN/Infinity/-Infinity/-0/undefined values prevent JSON loss.
method.replay: Direct JSON.stringify(recorder.finish(...)) byte equality, no normalization.
method.metadata: All 50 registered specs including split child and all function source strings; all TYPES and COST values; explicit 49 boss costs, base HP, collision and target masks/effective layers; exact combat/target functions.
method.displayFields: BossAbilities.facts display attackLabel and attackAriaLabel changes are reported, not treated as mechanics. All other facts and all numeric stats remain exact.
method.contentRevision: ContentProfile.CONTENT_REVISION is recorded and independently validated as 64 lowercase hex; intentionally not required to match across a changed content release.
